findings.goalOnEphemeral: ephemeral thread does not support goals: 01a1c942-36ba-7342-a712-d4b3ea56c70c

account.account/usage/read: chatgpt authentication required to read token usage
account.account/rateLimits/read: chatgpt authentication required to read rate limits

reasons: turn/start has no per-request token cap field, so no single-turn ceiling can be expressed
config/read exposes no token-limit key, so no config-level ceiling exists either
thread/goal tokenBudget is cumulative across a thread goal: the first turn starts at tokensUsed=0 so it cannot be capped by it
usage arrives after the turn, so it measures spend without capping it
no price surface exists in the protocol, model list or config, so a cost ceiling has no unit
notTested: whether a goal budget is checked before the first inference of a turn
whether exceeding the budget aborts an in-flight turn
actual billed amount for any real turn

cases.title: turn/start is the only billing method and call() refuses it
detail: call() refuses turn/start; only startTurn (with a reservation hook) can send

cases.title: the server publishes its accepted method list
detail: enumerated 134 accepted methods, including turn/start and thread/goal/set

cases.title: model/list exposes no price, cost or credit field
detail: model gpt-6.1-sol lists 19 fields and none is a price

cases.title: config/read exposes no token-limit and no price key
detail: read 35654 bytes of config with no token-limit key and no price key

cases.title: thread/goal/set accepts a token budget on a persistent thread
detail: a cumulative goal token budget is accepted and reports tokensUsed; this is NOT a single-turn bound

cases.title: a goal budget cannot be attached to an ephemeral thread
detail: the ephemeral fresh-reviewer thread refuses goals, so a budget cannot be attached to it

evidence.message: ephemeral thread does not support goals: 01a1c942-36ba-7342-a712-d4b3ea56c70c

cases.title: account usage and rate-limit reads are unavailable
detail: neither account surface is readable here, so no server-side price or quota can be read

evidence.account/rateLimits/read: chatgpt authentication required to read rate limits

cases.title: the whole investigation sent no billing method
